portInfo.description: Niedersachsen Ports describes Wilhelmshaven as Germany’s sole deep-water port on the Jade, with an outer deep-water section and an inner harbour behind a dual-chamber sea lock that is independent of the tide. The published product mix is bulk, containers (JadeWeserPort), energy/LNG and project cargo — not a cruise brochure. The NPorts Port Information Guide nonetheless lists North Harbour / Hannoverkai with max LOA 300 m, ~325 m solid quay, 11 m alongside depth at harbour normal, electricity/freshwater/Wi‑Fi and no stationary cargo gear. A 2020 city press release documented Mein Schiff 6 berthing at Hannoverkai for classification/diving works with no crew shore leave during COVID restrictions — that is evidence the quay can take a large cruise ship for technical purposes, not evidence of a regular tourist call programme.

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask whether the call is passenger or technical/repair before booking tours.
